notes.after: death of Moses the servant of the LORD,
notes.text: When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “ יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

notes.after: Don’t be dismayed, for the LORD your God
notes.text: The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “ אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim).

notes.after: The king of Jericho was told, “Behold,
notes.text: “Behold”, from “ הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

notes.after: you and it of about two thousand cubits
notes.text: A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters, so 2,000 cubits is about 920 meters.
